mu_name_from: The old client's MuWeapons.cs:188 names spear group index 1 'Spear' against Item/Spear02.bmd, and MuMain's _enum.h agrees: MODEL__SPEAR = MODEL_SPEAR + 1.
why_this_one: The Beetle Monster carries it. CreateMonster's MONSTER_BEETLE_MONSTER branch sets `c->Weapon[0].Type = MODEL__SPEAR` - the double underscore is the client's own, to keep the plain Spear apart from the MODEL_SPEAR group base - and a beetle with an empty fist is a beetle holding nothing. It is also the second of the two items MuWeapons.cs gives the spear stance, so the table's narrowest row now has both of its entries.

stats.from: openmu/src/Persistence/Initialization/Version075/Items/Weapons.cs. See Spear03 for what each argument is.
stats.drop_level_note: 23 against the Dragon Lance's 15, which reads backwards for the plainer spear and is what the 0.75 row says. Transcribed as written.

stance_from: MuWeapons.cs:188, WeaponStance.Spear - one of the two, with the Dragon Lance. See Spear03's stance_from for the client's rule behind it.
sheet_from: Data/Item/Javelins03.OZJ (32x32) and Data/Item/sword12.OZJ (32x16), from MuMain; Javelins03 is byte-identical (md5) to LEGACY's old build. The .bmd names Javelins03.jpg on the head's 32 triangles and sword12.jpg on the shaft's 70. sword12 is shared with Sword12.bmd, which is not built.
material_note: Two islands and they follow MU's two meshes exactly, so each settles its own. wrought_iron for the pole, steel for the socket that holds the point.

islands.note: the pole and the point, one island of 32 triangles from z -133 to 210. Every triangle samples the dark, near-neutral lower half of Javelins03 - chroma under ten, not the brown MU paints timber in - so the whole length is dark iron.
the collar under the head, 70 triangles between z 79 and 119, on sword12's pale blue-grey lattice.
